General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – Lexington, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Timing Tensioner Pulley for the 1.3L / 16V (G13BB) engine
It will also work in conjunction with our timing upgrade kit, which converts the weaker timing components of the 1.3L / 8V engine (G13A) to the heavier more reliable G13BB engine timing components
OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Timing Tensioner Pulley
What Vehicle Does This Fit?
Suzuki models using the G13BB engine
Can be used with our conversion kit on: Suzuki Samurais 1986 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki Swift 2005 – 2011
